description: This file defines a Python class `TeamsManagementClient` for managing teams via a REST API in the LiteLLM proxy system. It includes methods for listing teams, paginated retrieval with filters, and getting available teams, utilizing HTTP requests with optional API key authentication.

classes.name: TeamsManagementClient
classes.description: Client for managing teams in LiteLLM proxy, providing methods to list teams, retrieve paginated team data with filters, and get available teams.

methods.description: Constructs request headers, including authorization if API key is set.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list( self, user_id: Optional[str] = None, organization_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of teams that the user belongs to, with optional filtering by user_id and organization_id.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] list_v2( self, user_id: Optional[str] = None, organization_id: Optional[str] = None, team_id: Optional[str] = None, team_alias: Optional[str] = None, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 10, sort_by: Optional[str] = None, sort_order: str = "asc", )
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of teams with additional filtering, sorting, and pagination options.

methods.description: Fetches a list of teams available for the user to join.
